hint.label: Austria

atoms.text: This picture shows a representation of the famous painting called Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer. That means the picture does not show the actual painting, but it looks similar to the original. Adele Bloch-Bauer was born in Vienna, Austria in 1881, to a Jewish banking family. The painting was painted by Gustav Klimt, a famous artist from Austria.
atoms.sound: ssml: This picture shows a representation of the famous painting called Portrait of Adele Block-Bauer. That means the picture does not show the actual painting, but it looks similar to the original. Adele Block-Bauer was born in Vienna, Austria in 1881 to a Jewish banking family. The painting was done by Gustav Klimt, a famous artist from Austria.

atoms.text: In 1941, the painting and many other things the family owned were stolen. After more than 60 years and many lawsuits, the painting was finally returned to the actual owner, Maria Altmann, a surviving niece of Adele Bloch-Bauer. Once the painting was returned to Maria Altmann, she decided to sell the painting for $135 million (£113 million) to an art collector. Today the painting is exhibited in the Neue Galerie Museum in New York City.
